mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals a shift toward monetary easing, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of expected corporate cash flows, thereby driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of macro-easing windows, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a risk-off reaction, reducing equity risk appetite and compressing discount rates, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of rate-hike windows, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.05 over any 2-year horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 50,000 jobs signals a strengthening labor market, prompting firms to increase investment in productive capacity and raising expected equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of strong-labor-market windows, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 40,000 jobs signals a weakening labor market, prompting firms to reduce investment and lowering expected equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of weak-labor-market windows, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.05 over any 2-year horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in retail sales (HOUST) above 10,000 units signals robust consumer demand, prompting firms to raise prices and expand production capacity, which compresses discount rates and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of high-demand windows, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in retail sales (HOUST) below 8,000 units signals weak consumer demand, prompting firms to cut prices and reduce production, which compresses discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of low-demand windows, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.05 over any 2-year horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 points signals a strengthening supply-side capacity, prompting firms to raise prices and invest in capacity expansion, which compresses discount rates and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of strong-supply windows, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90 points signals a weakening supply-side capacity, prompting firms to cut prices and reduce capacity, which compresses discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of weak-supply windows, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.05 over any 2-year horizon.
